intent: Metric 4: semantic model describes the PRs opened headline

edits.new_content:
version: 2
semantic_models:
- name: fct_github_release_day
  description: 'Metric 4 headline: PRs opened on release day against the Thursday before, one row per
    release day, with its breakdown (PRs opened, PRs merged, commits).'
  model: ref('fct_github_release_day')
  defaults:
    agg_time_dimension: release_day
  entities:
  - name: github_release_day
    type: primary
    expr: release_day_key
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          null_rule: never
  dimensions:
  - name: breakdown
    type: categorical
    description: Every activity's change. Report it with the headline.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          null_rule: never
  - name: release_day
    type: time
    description: GTA 6's release day.
    type_params:
      time_granularity: day
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          null_rule: never
  - name: baseline_start
    type: time
    description: First baseline day.
    type_params:
      time_granularity: day
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          null_rule: never
  - name: baseline_end
    type: time
    description: Last baseline day.
    type_params:
      time_granularity: day
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          null_rule: never
  measures:
  - name: github_release_day_change_measure
    agg: max
    expr: github_release_day_change
    description: PRs opened's release-day change, in percent.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: percent
          additivity: non_additive
          null_rule: NULL until PRs opened has a change.
  config:
    meta:
      dex:
        population:
          rule: One row for the configured release day (var github_release_day).
        assumptions:
        - decision: How the activities combine
          chosen: plain average of the per-activity percent changes
          evidence: precedent
          detail: the Day-Off Index averages its phrases' changes the same way; counts differ by 10x between
            PRs and commits, so changes are averaged, not counts
          column: github_release_day_change
        - decision: An activity not yet available
          chosen: headline NULL
          evidence: precedent
          detail: 'fct_day_off_index: an average over fewer parts is a different number'
          column: github_release_day_change
